blurb: Skydive Golden Gate offers skydiving experiences just 24 miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge. Guests fly over San Francisco landmarks like Angel Island, Alcatraz, and the Golden Gate Bridge, exiting the aircraft from two miles up. The experience includes free fall above the California coastline and rolling North Bay hills, landing safely back at Marin County Airport.
